rules.moa: PTM/HSAF-family tetramate macrolactam — a bioactivity-HETEROGENEOUS family. The family carries antifungal capacity (HSAF = heat-stable antifungal factor), while the named congener pactamide is reported with potent cytotoxicity against human cancer cell lines (PMID 27966343). Both are reported because they are not exclusive: most antifungals carry some cytotoxicity, and dropping either signal loses information a reader needs. Capacity-level, not a measured activity for this strain.
